concerns.text: The “Dataset Strategy” table lists five OpenNeuro datasets accessed via HuggingFace parquet shards (e.g., `https://huggingface.co/datasets/clane9/openneuro-fslr64k/…/test-00000-of-00016.parquet`). Parquet files contain only curated metadata, not the raw NIfTI fMRI volumes required for ROI extraction, GLM fitting, and synthetic data generation. Using these files will not provide the voxel‑wise time‑series needed for the planned statistical power analysis, making the cited datasets inappropriate for the research question.
